name: BACH_0171
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (77%)** · Ambiguous: Normal vs Benign · Careful review
Flagged (tier 3) because the 90% prediction set includes both Normal and Benign, with 0% invasive risk [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Normal 77%, Benign 20%, InSitu 3%, Invasive 0% | Favors Normal; negligible invasive risk |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign (90% target coverage, alpha 10%) | Cannot separate Normal from Benign |
| Reliability / OOD | 97% reliability; 36th OOD percentile (12/12 regions) [F6] | Typical input; no quality flag |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | True (same top class) | Independent backbones agree on top class |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (92%–95% similarity) [F5] | Nearest reference cases all Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 2, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Contribution -1.21 [F2], but 0/20 AI spot check makes it unreliable · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 7, 8, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (1.43, contribution -0.71) pushing away from invasion [F3] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 6, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (1.60, contribution -0.57) opposing invasion; caption inconsistent [F4] · Weak
- **Nuclear size** (regions 1, 5, 6) · context · Mean nuclear area 46.7 µm², 0th percentile in 3 sampled regions [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (mean +0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion 95% CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0), and top driver `normal_lobules` is unreliable (0/20 AI spot check).

## Could be wrong if
- A benign lesion is present; Benign is 20% likely and contrast case `BACH_0380` (90% similar) is Benign.
- Focal atypia or invasion exists in higher-risk regions **11, 3, 7, 8** despite low whole-image invasive probability.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 11, 3, 7, 8**: Highest heatmap risk (25% in region 11) and elevated pleomorphism or invasion scores.
2. **Regions 2, 10, 11**: Verify normal two-layered lobules directly, since the `normal_lobules` concept is unreliable (0/20 spot check).
3. **Regions 1, 5, 6**: Inspect sampled glands and nuclei (46.7 µm² mean area; 51–80 neoplastic-called cells) for benign changes.
